summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its issuance on 3 November 2026 of US$1.75bn 5.819% fixed/floating-rate senior unsecured notes due 2032 and US$2.5bn 6.262% fixed/floating-rate senior unsecured notes due 2037, totaling US$4.25bn, under an indenture dated 26 August 2009 as supplemented by a 42nd supplemental indenture dated 3 November 2026. The notes were offered under an effective Form F-3 shelf registration; HSBC will apply to list them on the NYSE. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch only spread and funding-cost implications.
